headline: Web servers now predict peptide structure, protein binding sites, and phosphosites
label: Protein Prediction Web Tools
summary: Recent tools package AlphaFold2, ESMFold, ESM-2, and graph networks into accessible web and CLI platforms for structural and functional prediction.
synthesis: The dominant thread is delivery of predictive computational methods as accessible web servers or platforms for protein structure and function annotation. Several items build on pretrained models: PEPstrMOD2 applies AlphaFold2 and ESMFold to chemically modified peptides, xBind uses ESM-2 embeddings with symmetry-aware graph neural networks, and SGGly uses ProtBERT embeddings with sequon and structural features. Other items address specific tasks: onsite provides alanine-decoy false localization rate estimation for phosphosite localization, BioMetAll v2.0 adds metal-specific scoring and side-chain descriptors for metal-binding sites, and CB-Dock3 extends blind docking with user-defined regions. What is new is the breadth of modification handling in PEPstrMOD2 (928 modifications, no length limit) and user-driven model construction in Deep-Interact Studio. The set is heterogeneous, and the shared element is the platform format rather than a single method.
